title: Webster
description:
S3 E16 — That's Rich
Webster learns that you can be rich without having a lot of money after he gets struck with lottery fever.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E17 — TV or Not TV
When George is assigned to children's sports after a popular segment on Webster's hockey team, he worries his career will be damaged.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E18 — Borrowed Time
Rob's dad kidnaps him and Webster tries to rally up support to try and find him.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E20 — A Friend in Need
Jerry dresses up like a clown and takes Webster to the leukemia ward at the children's hospital, where he makes a new friend and realizes how lucky he is to be healthy.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E21 — Almost Home
Webster's Uncle Jack has Webster visit him. Uncle Jack runs a foster home with a woman, but a conflict may force him to quit the home.

S2 E7 — Come Into My Parlor
Brenda attempts to ensnare a boy's affection by inviting him to her Saturday night party, and following Sandra's sneaky suggestion, she tells him the party's on Friday night--but the scheme backfires when her parents go out for the evening.

S2 E8 — The Wheel Of Misfortune
Mary flies out to California to take a spin on the popular game show 'Wheel of Fortune,' but is shocked to discover a smug Sandra as her opponent--much to the dismay of hosts Pat Sajak and Vanna White.

S2 E9 — Washington Affair
Sandra's efforts to win the attention of a famous congressman (Robert Hooks) become muddled when Brenda's art teacher (Jayne Kennedy) catches his eye--yet in her pursuit she falls for another famous personality: Billy Dee Williams.

S2 E10 — Temptations
When Mary (Marla Gibbs) accepts the 'glamorous' title of Chairwoman of the Church benefit variety show, she soon realizes it's really a dirty job and prays for a group like the 'Temptations' to save the show.

S2 E11 — Father's Day
A surprise visit by his Air Force dad prompts Calvin to bid farewell to the family in exchange for a new life abroad with his father.

S2 E12 — Matchmakers
In efforts to find Rose a permanent mate, Mary and Sandra resort to a video dating service that transforms Rose into a Tina Turner look-a-like which eventually leads to an embarrassing and hilarious outcome when she meets her match.

S2 E13 — Check Snub
When Pearl (Helen Martin) is refused her social security check because the computer lists her as deceased, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Rose (Alaina Reed) and Sandra (Jackée), join in the battle against bureaucracy, only to land themselves in jail.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E14 — Louise's Reunion
When Louise finds out about a new clause in George's will, she almost gives him cause to use it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E15 — A Bedtime Story
George's problems in the bedroom send him on a panicked search for solutions, from some of the most unlikely sources.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E16 — Florence Meets Mr. Right
When George and Louise meet Florence's intended, they worry that he may be too good to be true -- and soon find out they are exactly right.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E17 — Louise's Award
Louise's donation to charity might win her a special award, if George's 'donation' to a politician doesn't ruin her chances.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E18 — The Other Woman
Tom Willis' latest business trip may be his last if Helen finds out who he is traveling with and what kind of 'business' they have in mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E19 — The Hold Out
George gets caught between his morals and his money when his efforts to increase his take on a business deal turn him into an unlikely neighborhood hero.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E20 — The Ones You Love
The first casualty from George and Louise's vicious verbal battle could be the interviewer interested in their 'perfect marriage.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E12 — Suitcase Case
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E13 — Return Of The Barracuda
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E14 — Piano Movers
A great deal on a grand piano finds Lamont and Fred lodged in the apartment of a wealthy eccentric.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E1 — The Light Housekeeper
When Fred Sanford receives a slight injury in a car mishap, Lamont finds himself waiting on his father hand and foot. Fred rejects the idea of having Aunt Ethel help him around the house and settles for Lamont's zany plan to hire a housekeeper.
